sources.summary: QUINCHOPEL is the quincho of Opelmec, a company specializing in electromechanical works and projects in the city of Córdoba. It is located in a passageway, just a few meters from Av. Sabattini (Route 9), in the eastern area, in an elevated zone where houses, warehouses, and productive structures coexist. From there, it creates a social space with open views of the city.
